description: Scala source code defining the RuntimeConfig class for Spark, providing runtime configuration management via SparkConnectClient.

classes.name: RuntimeConfig
classes.description: A class providing runtime configuration management for Spark, allowing setting, getting, and unsetting configuration properties via SparkConnectClient.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a configuration key to a specified value.

methods.name: set (overloaded)
methods.description: Sets a configuration using a ConfigEntry and its value.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key, throws if not set.

methods.name: get (with default)
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key, returns default if not set.

methods.name: get (overloaded with ConfigEntry)
methods.description: Retrieves a typed configuration value for a ConfigEntry.

methods.name: get (overloaded with OptionalConfigEntry)
methods.description: Retrieves an optional typed configuration value.

methods.name: get (with default for ConfigEntry)
methods.description: Retrieves a typed configuration value with a default fallback.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key is set.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Returns an Option with the value for a key if set.

methods.name: isModifiable
methods.description: Checks if a key is modifiable.
